Component responsibilities | Component | Responsibility | New? | |---|---|---| | `foreman_server_web/router.ex` | Route two new GETs through the existing `:api` pipeline (Bearer plug) | Modify (add 2 routes) | | `foreman_server_web/controllers/project_controller.ex` | `show/2` and `index/2` actions; reads from `project_store`; emits `[:foreman_server, :project, :read]` and `[:foreman_server, :project, :list]` telemetry | New | | `foreman_server_web/controllers/command_controller.ex` | Allow `project.update` and `project.archive` in `@allowed_types`, `aggregate_prefix/1`, `id_field_for/1` | Modify (3 tables) | | `foreman_server/command_gateway.ex` | Add `project.update` and `project.archive` to `@allowed_operator_types`; add `validate_aggregate_id/1` clauses for both | Modify (2 surfaces) | | `foreman_server/command_router.ex` | Three-function API: `dispatch/2` (public, rejects `type: "run.start"` with `ArgumentError` naming `RunAdmission.start/2`), `dispatch_run_start/2` (public, owns the entire multi-step protocol via the private `do_dispatch/2`), and `do_dispatch/2` (`defp` private, the actual append primitive). No sentinel field/atom — `defp` privacy is the capability. | Modify (1 new public function + 1 new private function + 1 runtime guard) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/project.ex` | Extend `State` with `active_run_reservations: %{String.t() => reservation_metadata()}` (a map keyed by `run_id` storing canonical `command_id`, `sequence`, `run_start_payload`, and `project_id`); add `handle_command` for `project.reserve_run` (idempotent upsert into the map) and `project.release_run_reservation` (idempotent remove from the map); `project.archive` checks `map_size(state.active_run_reservations) == 0` before emitting `ProjectArchived`. `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReserved` folds the reservation metadata into the map; `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReservationReleased` removes the entry. The map is the projection of the event stream into state — fully derived from event log replay, no separate write. | Modify (State field + 2 new apply_events + 2 new handle_commands + 1 archive check) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/run.ex` | Add `project_id` field to `Run.State` (between `task_id` and `status`); `initial_state` sets `project_id: nil`; `RunStarted` `apply_event` populates `state.project_id` from the payload; terminal-event handlers (`RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunFlaggedStuck`, `RunBlocked`) emit `project_id: state.project_id` in the event payload so the reconciler can resolve the project from the event itself. The reconcile path uses `Run.load(run_id)` to rehydrate state. | Modify (1 State field + 1 apply_event + 5 handle_command event builders) | | `foreman_server/run_admission.ex` | Thin delegate. `start/2` calls `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` (the protocol owner). No protocol logic in this module — calling `RunAdmission.start/2` is equivalent to calling `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2`. The module exists to (a) give the public API a single documented name, (b) centralize the architecture test allowlist (only `RunAdmission` may call `dispatch_run_start/2`). The reconciler also calls `RunAdmission.start/2` to retry orphan reservations, using the idempotent reserve-and-run flow (the first step is idempotent when the run_id is already a key in the project's `active_run_reservations`). | New | | `foreman_server/run_lifecycle_reconciler.ex` | Supervised GenServer. **Responsibility A (terminal-event subscription):** subscribes to `RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunBlocked`, `RunFlaggedStuck`; reads `project_id` directly from the event payload (the typed event is the authoritative source); dispatches `project.release_run_reservation`. Sub-second happy-path release. **Responsibility B (scheduled crash-recovery pass, default 60s):** enumerates `(project_id, run_id)` pairs via `ProjectionStore.list_projects_with_active_runs/0` (projection used only for enumeration). For each pair, rehydrates `Run.load(run_id)` to read `Run.State.exists?` and `Run.State.terminal?` (event stream replay), and `Project.load(project_id)` to read `Project.State.active_run_reservations[run_id]` (event-stream-derived state). **Retry-not-release protocol:** if `Run.State.terminal? == true` → release. If `Run.State.exists? == false` → recover the reservation metadata from `active_run_reservations[run_id]` and call `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` to retry the run.start (the reserve is idempotent; the run.start uses the deterministic command_id so concurrent appends are merged via actor-level event dedup). If `Run.State.exists? == true` and `Run.State.terminal? == false` → retain. The protocol never releases on absence alone (TOCTOU closed). | New | | `foreman_server/events/project_run_reserved.ex` | `ProjectRunReserved{run_id, project_id, sequence, command_id, run_start_payload}` — append-only fact that a run was reserved; carries the canonical command ID and the full input needed to retry `run.start` (so the reconciler can recover the run.start payload from project state, not by re-scanning the event stream). `run_start_payload` is the verbatim input passed to `RunAdmission.start/2` (task_id, workflow_snapshot, etc.). | New | | `foreman_server/events/project_run_reservation_released.ex` | `ProjectRunReservationReleased{run_id, project_id, sequence, reason}` — append-only fact that a run was released | New | | `foreman_server/event_codec.ex` | Register `:project_run_reserved` and `:project_run_reservation_released` (typed modules + enforce_keys including `run_start_payload` for the reservation event). Extend `@enforce_keys_registry` for `RunCompleted` (`[:run_id, :project_id, :sequence]`), `RunFailed` (`[:run_id, :project_id, :sequence]`). Add `RunCancelled`, `RunFlaggedStuck`, and `RunBlocked` as typed events (currently untyped maps — AGENTS.md mandates typed events for every domain event): `RunCancelled => [:run_id, :project_id, :reason]`, `RunFlaggedStuck => [:run_id, :project_id, :flagged_at]`, `RunBlocked => [:run_id, :project_id, :phase_id, :reason]`. Both `@registry` and `@enforce_keys_registry` must be updated in lockstep (the comment at lines 80-83 of the existing codec explicitly requires this). | Modify (extend registry + 3 new event modules + 2 enforce_keys extensions) | | `foreman_server/projection_store.ex` | Add `list_projects_with_active_runs/0` (returns `[{project_id, [run_id]}]` from `ProjectRunReserved`-derived projection). The reconciler is the ONLY caller; this function is used for enumeration only. **No `run_projection/1`** — the reconciliation path uses `Run.load(run_id)` and the typed event payload for safety decisions, never a projection. The previous design's `run_projection/1` was removed because it relied on projection reads for safety decisions, which races the event-commit boundary. | Modify (1 new query function) | | `foreman_server/application.ex` | Add `RunLifecycleReconciler` to supervision tree under `ForemanServer.Supervisor`; configure `:run_reconciler_interval_ms` (default 60_000) | Modify (supervision tree) | | `foreman_server/workflow/dispatcher.ex` | Replace direct `CommandGateway.dispatch_system(%{type: "run.start", ...})` call with `RunAdmission.start/2` (the ONLY legitimate caller of `run.start`) | Modify (1 call site) | | `foreman_server/project_store.ex` | No change — `list/0` and `get/1` already exist | None | | `foreman_server/telemetry.ex` (or equivalent) | Emit `[:foreman_server, :project, :register | :update | :archive | :read | :list | :run_reserved | :run_reservation_released]` and `[:foreman_server, :reconciler, :terminal_release | :orphan_retry]` with `duration_ms`, `outcome`, optional `code`/`retryable` (note: `:orphan_retry` replaces the v1.0.0 `:orphan_released` event — v1.0.1+ does not release on absence, it retries) | Modify (extend handlers) | | `foreman_cli/cmd/foreman/project.go` (new) and `foreman_cli/cmd/foreman/main.go` (modify) | Five subcommands: `create`, `get`, `update`, `delete`, `list` | New + modify | | `foreman_cli/internal/client/client.go` | Exit-code mapping for 6 documented codes (0,1,2,3,4,5) | Modify (extend error handling) | | `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/cli-reference.md` | Document the new `project` subcommand grouping, exit codes, and the `delete` ↔ `archive` mapping | Modify | | `test/foreman_server_web/event_store_web_enforcement_test.exs` (new) | Mirror `event_store_enforcement_test.exs` for the web layer. Extend the allowlist to enforce the router-owned admission path: (a) every `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` call MUST be in `RunAdmission` (or `RunLifecycleReconciler` — the retry path); (b) every `CommandRouter.dispatch/2` call with `type: "run.start"` is rejected anywhere in production code (the runtime guard in `dispatch/2` rejects this; the test prevents regressions); (c) every `CommandGateway.dispatch_system/2` call with `type: "run.start"` is rejected anywhere in production code. Allowlist: `CommandRouter` (the `dispatch_run_start/2` function itself), `RunAdmission` (the protocol delegate), and `RunLifecycleReconciler` (the retry path). Excluded from the scan: `test/` and `run_test.exs` (aggregate unit tests call `Run.handle_command/2` directly and never dispatch through the router). | New | | `test/foreman_server/event_codec_test.exs` (existing) | Add coverage for the two new event types (round-trip encode/decode) | Modify (extend) | ### 2d. Telemetry emission points (codified) | Event | Emission point | Rationale | |---|---|---| | `[:foreman_server, :project, :read]` | `ProjectController.show/2` after read completes | Controller is the only ingress for reads; gateway is not on the path | | `[:foreman_server, :project, :list]` | `ProjectController.index/2` after read completes | Same as `:read` | | `[:foreman_server, :project, :register]` | `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2` after successful dispatch | Gateway is sole mutation ingress; emitting here covers both HTTP and direct-gateway callers | | `[:foreman_server, :project, :update]` | `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2` after successful dispatch | Same as `:register` | | `[:foreman_server, :project, :archive]` | `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2` after successful dispatch (success or `409 project_has_active_runs` — the aggregate rejected before append) | Same as `:register`; covers both the appended and the rejected cases | | `[:foreman_server, :project, :run_reserved]` | `RunAdmission.start/2` after step 1 (`project.reserve_run`) appends successfully | Coordinator is the only caller; covers every reservation across the happy-path and the reservation-then-compensate path | | `[:foreman_server, :project, :run_reservation_released]` | `RunAdmission.start/2` after **definitive-rejection compensation only** (`{:error, :phase_terminal}` / `{:error, :run_already_terminal}` — explicit allowlist), OR `RunLifecycleReconciler` after terminal-event release | The reservation is NEVER released on absence alone (TOCTOU); ambiguous failures retain the reservation and let the reconciler scheduled pass retry. Only two release sources in v1.0.1; emission is co-located with the dispatch that performed the release | | `[:foreman_server, :reconciler, :terminal_release]` | `RunLifecycleReconciler.handle_info` for terminal event after `project.release_run_reservation` dispatch | Responsibility A (sub-second happy-path release); reason `:terminal_event` | | `[:foreman_server, :reconciler, :orphan_retry]` | `RunLifecycleReconciler.handle_info` scheduled pass after re-dispatch of `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` for an orphan (Run absent, reservation present) | Responsibility B (60s crash-recovery pass); reason `:orphan` — **replaces the v1.0.0 `:orphan_released` event**; v1.0.1 does not release on absence, it retries | Verifies Task: docs/TRD/TRD-2026-002184c6-projects-crud.md#trd-020 Verifies: TRD-020 Satisfies: REQ-009 PRD ACs Proven: AC-009-4, AC-010-1, AC-010-2, AC-010-3 Proof of requirement: Target Files: Actions: Test AC: Dependencies: TRD-020

description:
## Task: TRD-004 TRD Reference: docs/TRD/TRD-2026-002184c6-projects-crud.md#trd-004 PRD Reference: #req-004 --- TRD Context --- ### 2a. Alternatives considered | Option | Approach | Verdict | |---|---|---| | **A** | In-process Phoenix `ProjectController`; mutations via existing `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2`; Go CLI subcommand grouping; web-layer CQRS test mirrors `event_store_enforcement_test.exs` | **Selected** — minimal new surface; matches existing `task`/`run` resource-route pattern; zero new infrastructure | | B | Action-based JSON-RPC façade (`POST /api/projects` with `action` field) | Rejected — breaks existing CLI conventions; harder to cache; deviates from `AGENTS.md` spirit | | C | Separate "projects-api" Phoenix sub-app | Rejected — violates "no new infrastructure" from `AGENTS.md`; doubles Bearer-plug/pipeline surface | ### 2b. System architecture (Option A) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph GoCLI["foreman CLI (packages/foreman_cli)"] Create["foreman project create"] Get["foreman project get"] Update["foreman project update"] Delete["foreman project delete"] List["foreman project list"] end subgraph Phoenix["foreman_server_web (Phoenix)"] Router["router.ex
+ 2 new GET routes"] PC["ProjectController
(new)"] CC["CommandController
(allowlist updated)"] end subgraph Core["foreman_server"] CG["CommandGateway
(allowlist + identity validator)"] CR["CommandRouter
(router-owned admission path;
private do_dispatch/2)"] DISP["Workflow Dispatcher
(existing; only caller of run.start)"] RA["RunAdmission (new)
thin delegate over
CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2"] RLR["RunLifecycleReconciler (new)
sub + scheduled pass;
retry-not-release for orphans"] PAct["Project aggregate actor
(extended: active_run_reservations map)"] RAct["Run aggregate actor
(extended: project_id field)"] PS["project_store
(read for list)"] PrS["ProjectionStore
(list_projects_with_active_runs/0
enumeration only — never for
safety decisions)"] end subgraph ES["EventStore (existing)"] Events[("foreman_events
+ projection store")] end Create --> CC Update --> CC Delete --> CC Get --> Router List --> Router Router --> PC PC --> PS CC --> CG CG --> CR CR --> PAct CR --> RAct PAct --> Events RAct --> Events PS --> Events DISP --> RA RA -->|step 1: project.reserve_run| CR RA -->|step 2: run.start
(deterministic command_id
from reservation)| CR RA -->|on definitive rejection only:
project.release_run_reservation| CR Events -->|terminal events
(carry project_id + run_id)| RLR RLR -->|terminal-event release:
project.release_run_reservation| CR RLR -->|scheduled-pass orphan recovery:
RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)| RA classDef new fill:#fff4e1,stroke:#d68500,stroke-width:2px class RA,RLR new ``` **Data flow:** - **Read (`GET /api/projects/:id`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.show/2` → `project_store.get/1` (no event appended, no command dispatched). - **Read (`GET /api/projects`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.index/2` → `project_store.list/0` (filtered by `include_archived?`; capped by `projects_list_max` config, default 1000). **`X-Total-Count` exposes the underlying full count of matching rows** (NOT the truncated body length); the body itself is capped at the configured limit and signals truncation via `meta.truncated: true`. - **Mutation (`POST /api/commands` with `project.update` / `project.archive`):** Phoenix router → `CommandController.create/2` → `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2` → identity validator (`validate_aggregate_id/1` for the new types) → `CommandRouter` → aggregate actor → event store. - **Run start (workflow dispatcher):** `Workflow.Dispatcher` → `RunAdmission.start/2` → step 1: `project.reserve_run` → step 2: `run.start` (deterministic `command_id` derived from the reservation, NO `admission:` sentinel — v1.0.1 removed it) → both dispatched via `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` → `defp do_dispatch/2` → respective aggregate actors → event store. **Compensation policy (definitive-rejection allowlist):** only `:phase_terminal` and `:run_already_terminal` failures at step 2 trigger `project.release_run_reservation` (step 3). All other failures (timeout, crash, transient) RETAIN the reservation; the reconciler scheduled pass retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from `Project.State.active_run_reservations[run_id]` (actor-level event dedup absorbs concurrent retries). The reservation is never released on absence alone — that would race a successful `run.start` and orphan the run. - **Reconciler (two access paths, one authoritative source):** - **Subscription path (sub-second happy path):** `RunLifecycleReconciler` subscribes to `RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunBlocked`, `RunFlaggedStuck` → reads `project_id` + `run_id` directly from the terminal event payload (no `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1` — terminal events carry `project_id`) → dispatches `project.release_run_reservation`. - **Scheduled path (60s crash recovery):** enumerates candidates via `ProjectionStore.list_projects_with_active_runs/0` → loads authoritative state via `Project.load(project_id)` (for the reservation metadata to re-dispatch) and `Run.load(run_id)` (to confirm the run is truly absent vs. just unsubscribed) → if `Run.State.exists? == false`, retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from the reservation. Never reads `project_id` from `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1`. **Single mutation surface:** `POST /api/commands` (per `AGENTS.md`). title: [trd:trd-2026-48f7b420-foreman-beads-task-provider:pr:1a] PR 1: Foundation (TaskProvider behaviour + BrRunner boundary + ProviderError + JsonSchemaCache + ConcurrencyLimiter + 3 surgical config updates)
description: PR 1 of TRD: TRD: Foreman × Beads Rust — Task-Provider Integration. Contains 22 tasks. Shippable state: Operators can register providers via `Application.put_env(:foreman_server, :task_provider, providers: [...])`. The `ForemanServer.TaskProvider` behaviour declares 11 callbacks (`name/0`, `capabilities/0`, `available?/0`, `list_ready/2`, `get/2`, `claim/3`, `complete/3`, `fail/3`, `reopen/3`, `set_priority/3`, `add_dependency/3`). The `ForemanServer.TaskProviders.BrRunner` behaviour defines `cmd/3` (arity 3) — the contract implemented by `SystemBrRunner` (sole `System.cmd("br", ...)` site) and `BrRunnerMock` (compile-time bound via `Application.compile_env`). The `ForemanServer.TaskProviders.JsonSchemaCache` GenServer fetches and caches `br schema` JSON outputs at boot, exposes `validate(:ready_issue, payload)` and `validate(:issue_details, payload)`, refreshes every 24h, and emits `[:foreman_server, :task_provider, :beads, :capabilities, :refreshed]` on contract-version change (REQ-002-3). The `ForemanServer.TaskProviders.ConcurrencyLimiter` GenServer enforces `max_in_flight: 4` + per-call `timeout_ms: 30_000` and emits `BR_TIMEOUT_QUEUE` envelopes on queue timeout. The `ForemanServer.TaskProviders.ProviderError` typed struct carries 7 allowlisted context keys. The `ForemanServer.TaskProviders.BeadsAdapter.CodeMap` data-only 12-row mapping mediates between `br.code` envelopes and Foreman closed-vocab codes via `CodeMap.ProviderErrorInput` (a two-layer API: Layer 1 `ProviderErrorInput` struct + `from_br_envelope/1`/`from_local/5` constructors; Layer 2 `translate/3`/`translate_unknown/3`/`build_provider_error/3` all share `(input, command, stderr_byte_count) :: %ProviderError{}`). v1 has no `SensitiveFieldScrubber` — REQ-019 redaction is emission-only: argv passed to `br` is unscrubbed (original). `scrub_argv/1` (defined in PR 1b's TRD-023) produces a verbatim-copy with sentinels replaced for telemetry/log/ProviderError.context only. PR 1a is foundation only — the 8 operational callback impls + per-project registry state + post-execution lifecycle wire-up land in PR 1b.
close_reason: PR-1a Foundation: 22 tasks closed. TaskProvider behaviour (11 callbacks), BrRunner boundary (SystemBrRunner sole System.cmd site replaced via Port.open), ProviderError (7 allowlisted context keys), JsonSchemaCache (24h TTL + capabilities refresh), ConcurrencyLimiter (4 in-flight + 30s timeout), 3 surgical config updates (boot child, providers config, telemetry). ## Test Task: TRD-012-TEST TRD Reference: docs/TRD/TRD-2026-002184c6-projects-crud.md#trd-012-test PRD Reference: #req-004 --- TRD Context --- ### 2a. Alternatives considered | Option | Approach | Verdict | |---|---|---| | **A** | In-process Phoenix `ProjectController`; mutations via existing `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2`; Go CLI subcommand grouping; web-layer CQRS test mirrors `event_store_enforcement_test.exs` | **Selected** — minimal new surface; matches existing `task`/`run` resource-route pattern; zero new infrastructure | | B | Action-based JSON-RPC façade (`POST /api/projects` with `action` field) | Rejected — breaks existing CLI conventions; harder to cache; deviates from `AGENTS.md` spirit | | C | Separate "projects-api" Phoenix sub-app | Rejected — violates "no new infrastructure" from `AGENTS.md`; doubles Bearer-plug/pipeline surface | ### 2b. System architecture (Option A) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph GoCLI["foreman CLI (packages/foreman_cli)"] Create["foreman project create"] Get["foreman project get"] Update["foreman project update"] Delete["foreman project delete"] List["foreman project list"] end subgraph Phoenix["foreman_server_web (Phoenix)"] Router["router.ex
+ 2 new GET routes"] PC["ProjectController
(new)"] CC["CommandController
(allowlist updated)"] end subgraph Core["foreman_server"] CG["CommandGateway
(allowlist + identity validator)"] CR["CommandRouter
(router-owned admission path;
private do_dispatch/2)"] DISP["Workflow Dispatcher
(existing; only caller of run.start)"] RA["RunAdmission (new)
thin delegate over
CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2"] RLR["RunLifecycleReconciler (new)
sub + scheduled pass;
retry-not-release for orphans"] PAct["Project aggregate actor
(extended: active_run_reservations map)"] RAct["Run aggregate actor
(extended: project_id field)"] PS["project_store
(read for list)"] PrS["ProjectionStore
(list_projects_with_active_runs/0
enumeration only — never for
safety decisions)"] end subgraph ES["EventStore (existing)"] Events[("foreman_events
+ projection store")] end Create --> CC Update --> CC Delete --> CC Get --> Router List --> Router Router --> PC PC --> PS CC --> CG CG --> CR CR --> PAct CR --> RAct PAct --> Events RAct --> Events PS --> Events DISP --> RA RA -->|step 1: project.reserve_run| CR RA -->|step 2: run.start
(deterministic command_id
from reservation)| CR RA -->|on definitive rejection only:
project.release_run_reservation| CR Events -->|terminal events
(carry project_id + run_id)| RLR RLR -->|terminal-event release:
project.release_run_reservation| CR RLR -->|scheduled-pass orphan recovery:
RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)| RA classDef new fill:#fff4e1,stroke:#d68500,stroke-width:2px class RA,RLR new ``` **Data flow:** - **Read (`GET /api/projects/:id`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.show/2` → `project_store.get/1` (no event appended, no command dispatched). - **Read (`GET /api/projects`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.index/2` → `project_store.list/0` (filtered by `include_archived?`; capped by `projects_list_max` config, default 1000). **`X-Total-Count` exposes the underlying full count of matching rows** (NOT the truncated body length); the body itself is capped at the configured limit and signals truncation via `meta.truncated: true`. - **Mutation (`POST /api/commands` with `project.update` / `project.archive`):** Phoenix router → `CommandController.create/2` → `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2` → identity validator (`validate_aggregate_id/1` for the new types) → `CommandRouter` → aggregate actor → event store. - **Run start (workflow dispatcher):** `Workflow.Dispatcher` → `RunAdmission.start/2` → step 1: `project.reserve_run` → step 2: `run.start` (deterministic `command_id` derived from the reservation, NO `admission:` sentinel — v1.0.1 removed it) → both dispatched via `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` → `defp do_dispatch/2` → respective aggregate actors → event store. **Compensation policy (definitive-rejection allowlist):** only `:phase_terminal` and `:run_already_terminal` failures at step 2 trigger `project.release_run_reservation` (step 3). All other failures (timeout, crash, transient) RETAIN the reservation; the reconciler scheduled pass retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from `Project.State.active_run_reservations[run_id]` (actor-level event dedup absorbs concurrent retries). The reservation is never released on absence alone — that would race a successful `run.start` and orphan the run. - **Reconciler (two access paths, one authoritative source):** - **Subscription path (sub-second happy path):** `RunLifecycleReconciler` subscribes to `RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunBlocked`, `RunFlaggedStuck` → reads `project_id` + `run_id` directly from the terminal event payload (no `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1` — terminal events carry `project_id`) → dispatches `project.release_run_reservation`. - **Scheduled path (60s crash recovery):** enumerates candidates via `ProjectionStore.list_projects_with_active_runs/0` → loads authoritative state via `Project.load(project_id)` (for the reservation metadata to re-dispatch) and `Run.load(run_id)` (to confirm the run is truly absent vs. just unsubscribed) → if `Run.State.exists? == false`, retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from the reservation. Never reads `project_id` from `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1`. **Single mutation surface:** `POST /api/commands` (per `AGENTS.md`). Two new resource routes only (`GET /api/projects/:id`, `GET /api/projects`). All `run.start` dispatch flows through `RunAdmission` (the gateway allowlist does NOT include `run.start`; CLI/HTTP cannot bypass). ### 2c. ## Test Task: TRD-009-TEST TRD Reference: docs/TRD/TRD-2026-002184c6-projects-crud.md#trd-009-test PRD Reference: #req-008 --- TRD Context --- ### 2a. Alternatives considered | Option | Approach | Verdict | |---|---|---| | **A** | In-process Phoenix `ProjectController`; mutations via existing `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2`; Go CLI subcommand grouping; web-layer CQRS test mirrors `event_store_enforcement_test.exs` | **Selected** — minimal new surface; matches existing `task`/`run` resource-route pattern; zero new infrastructure | | B | Action-based JSON-RPC façade (`POST /api/projects` with `action` field) | Rejected — breaks existing CLI conventions; harder to cache; deviates from `AGENTS.md` spirit | | C | Separate "projects-api" Phoenix sub-app | Rejected — violates "no new infrastructure" from `AGENTS.md`; doubles Bearer-plug/pipeline surface | ### 2b. System architecture (Option A) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph GoCLI["foreman CLI (packages/foreman_cli)"] Create["foreman project create"] Get["foreman project get"] Update["foreman project update"] Delete["foreman project delete"] List["foreman project list"] end subgraph Phoenix["foreman_server_web (Phoenix)"] Router["router.ex
+ 2 new GET routes"] PC["ProjectController
(new)"] CC["CommandController
(allowlist updated)"] end subgraph Core["foreman_server"] CG["CommandGateway
(allowlist + identity validator)"] CR["CommandRouter
(router-owned admission path;
private do_dispatch/2)"] DISP["Workflow Dispatcher
(existing; only caller of run.start)"] RA["RunAdmission (new)
thin delegate over
CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2"] RLR["RunLifecycleReconciler (new)
sub + scheduled pass;
retry-not-release for orphans"] PAct["Project aggregate actor
(extended: active_run_reservations map)"] RAct["Run aggregate actor
(extended: project_id field)"] PS["project_store
(read for list)"] PrS["ProjectionStore
(list_projects_with_active_runs/0
enumeration only — never for
safety decisions)"] end subgraph ES["EventStore (existing)"] Events[("foreman_events
+ projection store")] end Create --> CC Update --> CC Delete --> CC Get --> Router List --> Router Router --> PC PC --> PS CC --> CG CG --> CR CR --> PAct CR --> RAct PAct --> Events RAct --> Events PS --> Events DISP --> RA RA -->|step 1: project.reserve_run| CR RA -->|step 2: run.start
(deterministic command_id
from reservation)| CR RA -->|on definitive rejection only:
project.release_run_reservation| CR Events -->|terminal events
(carry project_id + run_id)| RLR RLR -->|terminal-event release:
project.release_run_reservation| CR RLR -->|scheduled-pass orphan recovery:
RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)| RA classDef new fill:#fff4e1,stroke:#d68500,stroke-width:2px class RA,RLR new ``` **Data flow:** - **Read (`GET /api/projects/:id`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.show/2` → `project_store.get/1` (no event appended, no command dispatched). - **Read (`GET /api/projects`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.index/2` → `project_store.list/0` (filtered by `include_archived?`; capped by `projects_list_max` config, default 1000). **`X-Total-Count` exposes the underlying full count of matching rows** (NOT the truncated body length); the body itself is capped at the configured limit and signals truncation via `meta.truncated: true`. - **Mutation (`POST /api/commands` with `project.update` / `project.archive`):** Phoenix router → `CommandController.create/2` → `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2` → identity validator (`validate_aggregate_id/1` for the new types) → `CommandRouter` → aggregate actor → event store. - **Run start (workflow dispatcher):** `Workflow.Dispatcher` → `RunAdmission.start/2` → step 1: `project.reserve_run` → step 2: `run.start` (deterministic `command_id` derived from the reservation, NO `admission:` sentinel — v1.0.1 removed it) → both dispatched via `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` → `defp do_dispatch/2` → respective aggregate actors → event store. **Compensation policy (definitive-rejection allowlist):** only `:phase_terminal` and `:run_already_terminal` failures at step 2 trigger `project.release_run_reservation` (step 3). All other failures (timeout, crash, transient) RETAIN the reservation; the reconciler scheduled pass retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from `Project.State.active_run_reservations[run_id]` (actor-level event dedup absorbs concurrent retries). The reservation is never released on absence alone — that would race a successful `run.start` and orphan the run. - **Reconciler (two access paths, one authoritative source):** - **Subscription path (sub-second happy path):** `RunLifecycleReconciler` subscribes to `RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunBlocked`, `RunFlaggedStuck` → reads `project_id` + `run_id` directly from the terminal event payload (no `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1` — terminal events carry `project_id`) → dispatches `project.release_run_reservation`. - **Scheduled path (60s crash recovery):** enumerates candidates via `ProjectionStore.list_projects_with_active_runs/0` → loads authoritative state via `Project.load(project_id)` (for the reservation metadata to re-dispatch) and `Run.load(run_id)` (to confirm the run is truly absent vs. just unsubscribed) → if `Run.State.exists? == false`, retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from the reservation. Never reads `project_id` from `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1`. **Single mutation surface:** `POST /api/commands` (per `AGENTS.md`). Two new resource routes only (`GET /api/projects/:id`, `GET /api/projects`). All `run.start` dispatch flows through `RunAdmission` (the gateway allowlist does NOT include `run.start`; CLI/HTTP cannot bypass). ### 2c. Component responsibilities | Component | Responsibility | New? | |---|---|---| | `foreman_server_web/router.ex` | Route two new GETs through the existing `:api` pipeline (Bearer plug) | Modify (add 2 routes) | | `foreman_server_web/controllers/project_controller.ex` | `show/2` and `index/2` actions; reads from `project_store`; emits `[:foreman_server, :project, :read]` and `[:foreman_server, :project, :list]` telemetry | New | | `foreman_server_web/controllers/command_controller.ex` | Allow `project.update` and `project.archive` in `@allowed_types`, `aggregate_prefix/1`, `id_field_for/1` | Modify (3 tables) | | `foreman_server/command_gateway.ex` | Add `project.update` and `project.archive` to `@allowed_operator_types`; add `validate_aggregate_id/1` clauses for both | Modify (2 surfaces) | | `foreman_server/command_router.ex` | Three-function API: `dispatch/2` (public, rejects `type: "run.start"` with `ArgumentError` naming `RunAdmission.start/2`), `dispatch_run_start/2` (public, owns the entire multi-step protocol via the private `do_dispatch/2`), and `do_dispatch/2` (`defp` private, the actual append primitive). No sentinel field/atom — `defp` privacy is the capability. | Modify (1 new public function + 1 new private function + 1 runtime guard) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/project.ex` | Extend `State` with `active_run_reservations: %{String.t() => reservation_metadata()}` (a map keyed by `run_id` storing canonical `command_id`, `sequence`, `run_start_payload`, and `project_id`); add `handle_command` for `project.reserve_run` (idempotent upsert into the map) and `project.release_run_reservation` (idempotent remove from the map); `project.archive` checks `map_size(state.active_run_reservations) == 0` before emitting `ProjectArchived`. `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReserved` folds the reservation metadata into the map; `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReservationReleased` removes the entry. The map is the projection of the event stream into state — fully derived from event log replay, no separate write. | Modify (State field + 2 new apply_events + 2 new handle_commands + 1 archive check) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/run.ex` | Add `project_id` field to `Run.State` (between `task_id` and `status`); `initial_state` sets `project_id: nil`; `RunStarted` `apply_event` populates `state.project_id` from the payload; terminal-event handlers (`RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunFlaggedStuck`, `RunBlocked`) emit `project_id: state.project_id` in the event payload so the reconciler can resolve the project from the event itself. The reconcile path uses `Run.load(run_id)` to rehydrate state. | Modify (1 State field + 1 apply_event + 5 handle_command event builders) | | `foreman_server/run_admission.ex` | Thin delegate. `start/2` calls `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` (the protocol owner). No protocol logic in this module — calling `RunAdmission.start/2` is equivalent to calling `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2`. The module exists to (a) give the public API a single documented name, (b) centralize the architecture test allowlist (only `RunAdmission` may call `dispatch_run_start/2`). title: Create a Foreman MCP server covering all existing commands and agentic UI
description:
## Goal

Build a **Foreman MCP server** that exposes Foreman's external surfaces as MCP tools/resources, so any MCP-aware agentic client (Claude Code, Cline, custom UIs, etc.) can drive Foreman without hand-rolling HTTP clients.

## Required deliverable: Command Inventory

Before scope is called complete, the TRD must include a **complete inventory of all command types currently handled by `ForemanServer.Aggregate.handle_command/2`**, classified into three buckets. The inventory must be **derived from the actual codebase**, not paraphrased from memory.

### Bucket A — External public (must be MCP tools)

These are reachable today without supervisor/OTP access.

**HTTP mutations** — gated by `ForemanServer.CommandGateway.@allowed_operator_types` (`packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server/command_gateway.ex:41`):

| Type | Source |
|---|---|
| `project.register` | `aggregates/project.ex` |
| `project.update` | `aggregates/project.ex` |
| `project.archive` | `aggregates/project.ex` |
| `task.create` | `aggregates/task.ex` |
| `task.approve` | `aggregates/task.ex` |

**HTTP queries** — `packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server_web/router.ex`:

| Method + Path | Source |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/projects` | `ProjectController.index` |
| `GET /api/projects/:id` | `ProjectController.show` |
| `GET /api/tasks/:id` | `TaskController.show` |
| `GET /api/runs/:id` | `RunController.show` |
| `POST /api/admin/workflows/install` | `WorkflowInstallController.install` |
| `POST /webhooks/external_trigger` | `WebhookController.external_trigger` |
| `POST /webhooks/github` | `GithubWebhookController.github` |

**Existing CLI surface** — `packages/foreman_cli/cmd/foreman/main.go:68` and per-resource `*.go` files. The TRD must reconcile the CLI subcommand list against the inventory and flag any CLI subcommand that has no equivalent MCP tool, or any HTTP capability that no CLI subcommand covers.

### Bucket B — Recovery / operator-extensible (MCP policy: opt in explicitly)

Handled by aggregate `handle_command/2` but **NOT** in `@allowed_operator_types`. Reachable today only via `ForemanServer.CommandGateway.dispatch_system/1` (`command_gateway.ex:71`). The TRD must define, per type, whether the MCP server exposes it (and under which capability — e.g. read-only `foreman-system:recovery` requiring a server-side flag, or always-on for operators with a configured `mcp_allow_system: true`).

Known examples the TRD must consider (non-exhaustive — full enumeration comes from `aggregates/*/ex`):

- `task.block`, `task.close`, `task.update`, `task.annotate`, `task.dispatch`, `task.add_dependency` — `aggregates/task.ex`
- `project.reactivate` — `aggregates/project.ex`
- `task.execution_complete`, `task.execution_fail` — `aggregates/task.ex` (currently emitted by `RunExecutor.dispatch_task_execution_complete/1`)

The TRD's policy must default-deny any type not in Bucket A and require an explicit allow-list entry for each Bucket B exposure.

### Bucket C — System-internal (MCP server MUST NOT expose)

Handled by aggregate `handle_command/2`, only emitted by OTP-internal code paths. These are server-side bookkeeping — run lifecycle, scheduling, recovery, VCS, projections. Exposing them via MCP would let external clients race the supervisor. The TRD must list each and explain why direct MCP exposure is forbidden.

- **Run lifecycle** (`aggregates/run.ex`): `run.start`, `run.update`, `run.delete`, `run.complete`, `run.pause`, `run.cancel`, `run.fail`, `run.block`, `run.flag_stuck`, `run.pr.update`, `run.pr.ready`, `run.recovery_event`. Emitted by `RunAdmission.start/3`, `RunExecutor`, `StuckDetector`, `PRMonitor`, `Operations`.
- **Phase lifecycle** (`aggregates/phase.ex`): `phase.start`, `phase.complete`, `phase.fail`, `phase.timeout`, `phase.retry`, `phase.skip`. Emitted by `RunExecutor.run_single_phase/3`.
- **Worker** (`aggregates/worker.ex`): `worker.record`. Emitted by the worker runtime.
- **Tool calls** (`aggregates/tool_call.ex`): `tool.request`, `tool.approve`, `tool.deny`, `tool.finish`. Emitted by agent-runtime tool policy.
- **Operator intervention** (`aggregates/operator_intervention.ex`): `operator.needs`, `operator.interrupt`, `operator.resume`. Emitted by agent runtime and supervisor.
- **Planning flow** (`aggregates/planning_flow.ex`): `planning.start`, `planning.command`, `planning.trace.link`, `planning.complete`, `plan.prd`, `plan.trd`. Emitted by `Workflow.Dispatcher` and plan-phase worker.
- **Recovery** (`aggregates/recovery.ex`): `recovery.detected`, `recovery.observe_external_worker`, `recovery.require`, … Emitted by `ForemanServer.Operations.detect_recovery/2` and the Overwatch `CrashLoopDetector` / `Tracker`.
- **Scheduler** (`aggregates/scheduler.ex`, `aggregates/scheduler_intent.ex`): `scheduler.tick`, `scheduler.claim`, `scheduler.skip`, `scheduler_intent.record|confirm|skip|mark_stale`. Emitted by the scheduler supervisor.
- **Stream gap detector** (`aggregates/stream_gap_detector.ex`): `stream_gap.report`, `stream_gap.resolve`. Emitted by projection reconciliation.
- **Artifact / report** (`aggregates/artifact_report.ex`): `phase.report.produce`, `phase.verdict`. Emitted by phase completion path.
- **Attachment** (`aggregates/attachment.ex`): `attach.request`, `attach.unsupported`. Emitted by worker tool calls.
- **Board item state machine** (`aggregates/board_item_state_machine.ex`): `board_item.create`, `board_item.transition`. Internal projection transitions.
- **External trigger** (`aggregates/external_trigger.ex`): `external.trigger`, `external.accept`, `external.worker.observe`. Emitted by `WebhookController.external_trigger`.
- **Import migration** (`aggregates/import_migration.ex`): `migration.import.start`, `migration.record.import`, `migration.import.complete`. Emitted by `ForemanServer.MigrationImporter`.
- **Inbox thread** (`aggregates/inbox_thread.ex`): `inbox.send`, `inbox.delivery.update`. Inter-agent messaging.
- **Integration** (`aggregates/integration.ex`): `integration.ingest`, `integration.configure`, `integration.sync.request`, `integration.sync.complete`. Emitted by integration supervisor.
- **PR association** (`aggregates/pr_association.ex`): `pr.associate`. Emitted by `PRMonitor`.
- **Project run limit** (`aggregates/project_run_limit.ex`): `run_limit.reserve`, `run_limit.release`. Emitted by `RunAdmission`.
- **VCS operation** (`aggregates/vcs_operation.ex`): `vcs.worktree.create`, `vcs.worktree.clean`, …, `vcs_operation.start`, `vcs_operation.complete`, `vcs_operation.fail`. Emitted by `VcsAdapter.Default`.

The TRD inventory must cross-check this list against an actual `grep "def handle_command" packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server/aggregates/*.ex` and confirm zero Bucket-C types leak into Bucket A or B.

## Scope (in)

1. **Bucket A**: every type and route above becomes an MCP tool or resource. Render-ready Markdown result shapes for beads/runs; structured JSON for raw lookups.
2. **Bucket B**: policy-driven opt-in per type. Defaults to deny. Each enabled type gets its own capability flag in MCP server config.
3. **Bucket C**: enumerated in the inventory; never exposed as MCP tools. Listed in the docs as "intentionally not exposed" with rationale.
4. **Agentic UI affordances**:
   - Idempotency keys auto-generated and surfaced in tool descriptions.
   - Streaming/long-running tool variant for `run.watch` (events stream).
   - Built-in MCP resources surfacing "what is Foreman doing right now" (active runs, blocked tasks, recent failures).
5. **Transport**: stdio (default for local agentic CLIs) and Streamable HTTP (for hosted UIs). Single binary or single Elixir app; pick the one with least ongoing surface.
6. **Auth**: reuse the existing bearer-token model (`config :foreman_server, :api_bearer_token`). MCP server MUST NOT bypass auth; `BearerAuth` plug runs on every request, including local stdio transport.

## Scope (out)

- Do NOT add new domain commands beyond what already exists in `CommandGateway`.
- Do NOT redesign the Go CLI; MCP is a parallel ingress.
- Do NOT replace the Phoenix HTTP API; both must coexist.
- Do NOT expose Bucket C types as MCP tools (architectural invariant).

## Open questions to resolve in TRD

1. **Server language**: separate Go binary vs. Elixir Plug/Phoenix sub-app. Elixir keeps a single runtime and reads projections directly; Go keeps MCP dependencies isolated. Pick one and justify.
2. **State observation**: does the MCP server attach to EventStore tail / subscribe to Phoenix pubsub, or does it poll projections? Tradeoff vs. coupling.
3. **Tool granularity**: one tool per command type (verbose) vs. one `dispatch` tool with typed `command_type` arg (compact). Recommend the latter for parity with existing API; document the Bucket-A exception list (`approve` deserves its own tool for discoverability, since it takes a snapshot).
4. **Bucket B default policy**: server-wide allow-list vs. per-MCP-client capability token.

## Reference

- Aggregate inventory source of truth: `packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server/aggregates/*/ex` (`def handle_command/2` clauses)
- Operator allow-list: `packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server/command_gateway.ex` (`@allowed_operator_types`)
- System dispatch path: `packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server/command_gateway.ex` (`dispatch_system/1`)
- HTTP routes: `packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server_web/router.ex`
- Existing CLI: `packages/foreman_cli/cmd/foreman/main.go` and `project.go` / `task.go` / `run.go` / `workflow.go`
- Webhooks: `packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server_web/controllers/*_webhook_controller.ex`
- Auth plug: `packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server_web/plugs/bearer_auth.ex`
- Existing aggregate-to-system-dispatch call sites (proves which types are emitted by which supervisor component): `grep -rn 'dispatch_system' packages/foreman_server/lib/foreman_server/`

## Acceptance (planning level)

- PRD and TRD exist under `docs/PRD/` and `docs/TRD/`.
- TRD inventory section enumerates every `handle_command/2` type across `aggregates/*` and classifies it A / B / C with rationale.
- TRD lists Bucket B types explicitly with per-type allow-list policy.
- TRD names the agentic-UI surface and shows a worked end-to-end example: agent asks "what tasks are blocked on `foreman`?" → MCP server answers with rendered Markdown using only Bucket A and (if enabled) Bucket B types.
- Architecture decision recorded for (1) language, (2) observation model, (3) tool granularity, (4) Bucket B default policy.

description: PR 3 of TRD: TRD: Atomic Beads Task-Create and JSONL Watcher. Contains 11 tasks. Shippable state: The bi-directional sync is live. The watcher forwards Beads-side operator-managed beads to Foreman as `task.create` commands via `CommandGateway.dispatch_system/2`; the orphan janitor closes the Foreman-side strands. The `ProjectionStore` `TaskCreated` handler stores `external_id` (legacy events default to `nil`). The flags `:start_beads_watcher?` / `:start_beads_orphan_janitor?` default to `false` in `config/test.exs` and are documented in `config/runtime.exs`. With both flags `true`, the supervisor boots `BeadsWatcher` and `BeadsOrphanJanitor` per registered project.

title: Intercom-style agent-to-agent communications for Foreman
description:
Add intercom-style direct messaging between Foreman-managed pi agents, modeled on https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-intercom (commit 8b189e8668a3335c92f7fbd8531363502e924a9b).

Problem: today Foreman runs agents in isolation per run. When the same session needs to coordinate (planner handing off to executor, reviewer asking implementer for context, subagent needing a supervisor decision), coordination has to round-trip through file artifacts or operator intervention.

Scope:
- Foreman provides a supervised GenServer ("intercom broker") under Application that owns the live registry of connected sessions / workers / subagents and routes direct messages by recipient id.
- The local IPC transport from pi-intercom is replaced by Phoenix PubSub or a GenServer.cast / GenServer.call boundary inside the runtime.
- Every send / receive / ask / reply event is appended to the event log (matching the ForemanServer.CommandRouter pattern) and projected into the existing inbox projection so messages are queryable and replayable.
- A pi-intercom-shaped tool is exposed to in-runtime agents; the agent-facing surface mirrors pi-intercom's `intercom` and `contact_supervisor` tools, including the `need_decision` / `interview_request` / `progress_update` reason taxonomy from pi-subagents integration.
- All events flow through CommandRouter dispatch; no module writes to the event store directly.

Non-goals:
- Cross-machine IPC.
- Persistent cross-run message history beyond what the event log already retains.
- UI overlay (Alt+M / /intercom) — the agent runtime is the only caller for Foreman.

Acceptance sketch:
- Sending a message from session A to session B causes exactly one append per direction to the event log, with both projections (inbox + run) updated.
- A `need_decision` message blocks the sender until the recipient replies or a configurable timeout elapses (the sender run is parked, not failed).
- Replay after restart reconstructs the inbox view without re-delivering live messages.

RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)| RA classDef new fill:#fff4e1,stroke:#d68500,stroke-width:2px class RA,RLR new ``` **Data flow:** - **Read (`GET /api/projects/:id`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.show/2` → `project_store.get/1` (no event appended, no command dispatched). - **Read (`GET /api/projects`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.index/2` → `project_store.list/0` (filtered by `include_archived?`; capped by `projects_list_max` config, default 1000). **`X-Total-Count` exposes the underlying full count of matching rows** (NOT the truncated body length); the body itself is capped at the configured limit and signals truncation via `meta.truncated: true`. - **Mutation (`POST /api/commands` with `project.update` / `project.archive`):** Phoenix router → `CommandController.create/2` → `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2` → identity validator (`validate_aggregate_id/1` for the new types) → `CommandRouter` → aggregate actor → event store. - **Run start (workflow dispatcher):** `Workflow.Dispatcher` → `RunAdmission.start/2` → step 1: `project.reserve_run` → step 2: `run.start` (deterministic `command_id` derived from the reservation, NO `admission:` sentinel — v1.0.1 removed it) → both dispatched via `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` → `defp do_dispatch/2` → respective aggregate actors → event store. **Compensation policy (definitive-rejection allowlist):** only `:phase_terminal` and `:run_already_terminal` failures at step 2 trigger `project.release_run_reservation` (step 3). All other failures (timeout, crash, transient) RETAIN the reservation; the reconciler scheduled pass retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from `Project.State.active_run_reservations[run_id]` (actor-level event dedup absorbs concurrent retries). The reservation is never released on absence alone — that would race a successful `run.start` and orphan the run. - **Reconciler (two access paths, one authoritative source):** - **Subscription path (sub-second happy path):** `RunLifecycleReconciler` subscribes to `RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunBlocked`, `RunFlaggedStuck` → reads `project_id` + `run_id` directly from the terminal event payload (no `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1` — terminal events carry `project_id`) → dispatches `project.release_run_reservation`. - **Scheduled path (60s crash recovery):** enumerates candidates via `ProjectionStore.list_projects_with_active_runs/0` → loads authoritative state via `Project.load(project_id)` (for the reservation metadata to re-dispatch) and `Run.load(run_id)` (to confirm the run is truly absent vs. just unsubscribed) → if `Run.State.exists? == false`, retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from the reservation. Never reads `project_id` from `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1`. **Single mutation surface:** `POST /api/commands` (per `AGENTS.md`). Two new resource routes only (`GET /api/projects/:id`, `GET /api/projects`). All `run.start` dispatch flows through `RunAdmission` (the gateway allowlist does NOT include `run.start`; CLI/HTTP cannot bypass). ### 2c. Component responsibilities | Component | Responsibility | New? | |---|---|---| | `foreman_server_web/router.ex` | Route two new GETs through the existing `:api` pipeline (Bearer plug) | Modify (add 2 routes) | | `foreman_server_web/controllers/project_controller.ex` | `show/2` and `index/2` actions; reads from `project_store`; emits `[:foreman_server, :project, :read]` and `[:foreman_server, :project, :list]` telemetry | New | | `foreman_server_web/controllers/command_controller.ex` | Allow `project.update` and `project.archive` in `@allowed_types`, `aggregate_prefix/1`, `id_field_for/1` | Modify (3 tables) | | `foreman_server/command_gateway.ex` | Add `project.update` and `project.archive` to `@allowed_operator_types`; add `validate_aggregate_id/1` clauses for both | Modify (2 surfaces) | | `foreman_server/command_router.ex` | Three-function API: `dispatch/2` (public, rejects `type: "run.start"` with `ArgumentError` naming `RunAdmission.start/2`), `dispatch_run_start/2` (public, owns the entire multi-step protocol via the private `do_dispatch/2`), and `do_dispatch/2` (`defp` private, the actual append primitive). No sentinel field/atom — `defp` privacy is the capability. | Modify (1 new public function + 1 new private function + 1 runtime guard) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/project.ex` | Extend `State` with `active_run_reservations: %{String.t() => reservation_metadata()}` (a map keyed by `run_id` storing canonical `command_id`, `sequence`, `run_start_payload`, and `project_id`); add `handle_command` for `project.reserve_run` (idempotent upsert into the map) and `project.release_run_reservation` (idempotent remove from the map); `project.archive` checks `map_size(state.active_run_reservations) == 0` before emitting `ProjectArchived`. `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReserved` folds the reservation metadata into the map; `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReservationReleased` removes the entry. The map is the projection of the event stream into state — fully derived from event log replay, no separate write. | Modify (State field + 2 new apply_events + 2 new handle_commands + 1 archive check) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/run.ex` | Add `project_id` field to `Run.State` (between `task_id` and `status`); `initial_state` sets `project_id: nil`; `RunStarted` `apply_event` populates `state.project_id` from the payload; terminal-event handlers (`RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunFlaggedStuck`, `RunBlocked`) emit `project_id: state.project_id` in the event payload so the reconciler can resolve the project from the event itself. The reconcile path uses `Run.load(run_id)` to rehydrate state. | Modify (1 State field + 1 apply_event + 5 handle_command event builders) | | `foreman_server/run_admission.ex` | Thin delegate. `start/2` calls `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` (the protocol owner). No protocol logic in this module — calling `RunAdmission.start/2` is equivalent to calling `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2`. The module exists to (a) give the public API a single documented name, (b) centralize the architecture test allowlist (only `RunAdmission` may call `dispatch_run_start/2`). The reconciler also calls `RunAdmission.start/2` to retry orphan reservations, using the idempotent reserve-and-run flow (the first step is idempotent when the run_id is already a key in the project's `active_run_reservations`). | New | | `foreman_server/run_lifecycle_reconciler.ex` | Supervised GenServer. **Responsibility A (terminal-event subscription):** subscribes to `RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunBlocked`, `RunFlaggedStuck`; reads `project_id` directly from the event payload (the typed event is the authoritative source); dispatches `project.release_run_reservation`. ## Test Task: TRD-010-TEST TRD Reference: docs/TRD/TRD-2026-002184c6-projects-crud.md#trd-010-test PRD Reference: #req-012 --- TRD Context --- ### 2a. Alternatives considered | Option | Approach | Verdict | |---|---|---| | **A** | In-process Phoenix `ProjectController`; mutations via existing `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2`; Go CLI subcommand grouping; web-layer CQRS test mirrors `event_store_enforcement_test.exs` | **Selected** — minimal new surface; matches existing `task`/`run` resource-route pattern; zero new infrastructure | | B | Action-based JSON-RPC façade (`POST /api/projects` with `action` field) | Rejected — breaks existing CLI conventions; harder to cache; deviates from `AGENTS.md` spirit | | C | Separate "projects-api" Phoenix sub-app | Rejected — violates "no new infrastructure" from `AGENTS.md`; doubles Bearer-plug/pipeline surface | ### 2b. System architecture (Option A) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph GoCLI["foreman CLI (packages/foreman_cli)"] Create["foreman project create"] Get["foreman project get"] Update["foreman project update"] Delete["foreman project delete"] List["foreman project list"] end subgraph Phoenix["foreman_server_web (Phoenix)"] Router["router.ex
+ 2 new GET routes"] PC["ProjectController
(new)"] CC["CommandController
(allowlist updated)"] end subgraph Core["foreman_server"] CG["CommandGateway
(allowlist + identity validator)"] CR["CommandRouter
(router-owned admission path;
private do_dispatch/2)"] DISP["Workflow Dispatcher
(existing; only caller of run.start)"] RA["RunAdmission (new)
thin delegate over
CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2"] RLR["RunLifecycleReconciler (new)
sub + scheduled pass;
retry-not-release for orphans"] PAct["Project aggregate actor
(extended: active_run_reservations map)"] RAct["Run aggregate actor
(extended: project_id field)"] PS["project_store
(read for list)"] PrS["ProjectionStore
(list_projects_with_active_runs/0
enumeration only — never for
safety decisions)"] end subgraph ES["EventStore (existing)"] Events[("foreman_events
+ projection store")] end Create --> CC Update --> CC Delete --> CC Get --> Router List --> Router Router --> PC PC --> PS CC --> CG CG --> CR CR --> PAct CR --> RAct PAct --> Events RAct --> Events PS --> Events DISP --> RA RA -->|step 1: project.reserve_run| CR RA -->|step 2: run.start
(deterministic command_id
from reservation)| CR RA -->|on definitive rejection only:
project.release_run_reservation| CR Events -->|terminal events
(carry project_id + run_id)| RLR RLR -->|terminal-event release:
project.release_run_reservation| CR RLR -->|scheduled-pass orphan recovery:
RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)| RA classDef new fill:#fff4e1,stroke:#d68500,stroke-width:2px class RA,RLR new ``` **Data flow:** - **Read (`GET /api/projects/:id`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.show/2` → `project_store.get/1` (no event appended, no command dispatched). - **Read (`GET /api/projects`):** Phoenix router → `ProjectController.index/2` → `project_store.list/0` (filtered by `include_archived?`; capped by `projects_list_max` config, default 1000). **`X-Total-Count` exposes the underlying full count of matching rows** (NOT the truncated body length); the body itself is capped at the configured limit and signals truncation via `meta.truncated: true`. - **Mutation (`POST /api/commands` with `project.update` / `project.archive`):** Phoenix router → `CommandController.create/2` → `CommandGateway.dispatch_operator/2` → identity validator (`validate_aggregate_id/1` for the new types) → `CommandRouter` → aggregate actor → event store. - **Run start (workflow dispatcher):** `Workflow.Dispatcher` → `RunAdmission.start/2` → step 1: `project.reserve_run` → step 2: `run.start` (deterministic `command_id` derived from the reservation, NO `admission:` sentinel — v1.0.1 removed it) → both dispatched via `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` → `defp do_dispatch/2` → respective aggregate actors → event store. **Compensation policy (definitive-rejection allowlist):** only `:phase_terminal` and `:run_already_terminal` failures at step 2 trigger `project.release_run_reservation` (step 3). All other failures (timeout, crash, transient) RETAIN the reservation; the reconciler scheduled pass retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from `Project.State.active_run_reservations[run_id]` (actor-level event dedup absorbs concurrent retries). The reservation is never released on absence alone — that would race a successful `run.start` and orphan the run. - **Reconciler (two access paths, one authoritative source):** - **Subscription path (sub-second happy path):** `RunLifecycleReconciler` subscribes to `RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunBlocked`, `RunFlaggedStuck` → reads `project_id` + `run_id` directly from the terminal event payload (no `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1` — terminal events carry `project_id`) → dispatches `project.release_run_reservation`. - **Scheduled path (60s crash recovery):** enumerates candidates via `ProjectionStore.list_projects_with_active_runs/0` → loads authoritative state via `Project.load(project_id)` (for the reservation metadata to re-dispatch) and `Run.load(run_id)` (to confirm the run is truly absent vs. just unsubscribed) → if `Run.State.exists? == false`, retries `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` with the deterministic `command_id` from the reservation. Never reads `project_id` from `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1`. **Single mutation surface:** `POST /api/commands` (per `AGENTS.md`). Two new resource routes only (`GET /api/projects/:id`, `GET /api/projects`). All `run.start` dispatch flows through `RunAdmission` (the gateway allowlist does NOT include `run.start`; CLI/HTTP cannot bypass). ### 2c. Component responsibilities | Component | Responsibility | New? | |---|---|---| | `foreman_server_web/router.ex` | Route two new GETs through the existing `:api` pipeline (Bearer plug) | Modify (add 2 routes) | | `foreman_server_web/controllers/project_controller.ex` | `show/2` and `index/2` actions; reads from `project_store`; emits `[:foreman_server, :project, :read]` and `[:foreman_server, :project, :list]` telemetry | New | | `foreman_server_web/controllers/command_controller.ex` | Allow `project.update` and `project.archive` in `@allowed_types`, `aggregate_prefix/1`, `id_field_for/1` | Modify (3 tables) | | `foreman_server/command_gateway.ex` | Add `project.update` and `project.archive` to `@allowed_operator_types`; add `validate_aggregate_id/1` clauses for both | Modify (2 surfaces) | | `foreman_server/command_router.ex` | Three-function API: `dispatch/2` (public, rejects `type: "run.start"` with `ArgumentError` naming `RunAdmission.start/2`), `dispatch_run_start/2` (public, owns the entire multi-step protocol via the private `do_dispatch/2`), and `do_dispatch/2` (`defp` private, the actual append primitive). No sentinel field/atom — `defp` privacy is the capability. | Modify (1 new public function + 1 new private function + 1 runtime guard) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/project.ex` | Extend `State` with `active_run_reservations: %{String.t() => reservation_metadata()}` (a map keyed by `run_id` storing canonical `command_id`, `sequence`, `run_start_payload`, and `project_id`); add `handle_command` for `project.reserve_run` (idempotent upsert into the map) and `project.release_run_reservation` (idempotent remove from the map); `project.archive` checks `map_size(state.active_run_reservations) == 0` before emitting `ProjectArchived`. `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReserved` folds the reservation metadata into the map; `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReservationReleased` removes the entry. The map is the projection of the event stream into state — fully derived from event log replay, no separate write. | Modify (State field + 2 new apply_events + 2 new handle_commands + 1 archive check) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/run.ex` | Add `project_id` field to `Run.State` (between `task_id` and `status`); `initial_state` sets `project_id: nil`; `RunStarted` `apply_event` populates `state.project_id` from the payload; terminal-event handlers (`RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunFlaggedStuck`, `RunBlocked`) emit `project_id: state.project_id` in the event payload so the reconciler can resolve the project from the event itself. The reconcile path uses `Run.load(run_id)` to rehydrate state. | Modify (1 State field + 1 apply_event + 5 handle_command event builders) | | `foreman_server/run_admission.ex` | Thin delegate. `start/2` calls `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` (the protocol owner). title: ForemanServer logs do not write to ~/.foreman/logs/
description:
## Problem

The Elixir/Phoenix `foreman_server` writes its operational log only to `/tmp/foreman-server-stopgated.log` (the path passed via the manual `hub start … tee` invocation). It does not write to `~/.foreman/logs/`. That directory is inherited from the legacy Node.js `foreman` daemon; its last write was 2026-07-26 12:57.

## Why this matters

1. Operators tail `~/.foreman/logs/` by convention; absence of new entries looks like a hung server, not a path mismatch.
2. `~/.foreman/logs/<uuid>.err/.log/.out` triples give per-run isolation. Tmp-log single files interleave boot, supervisor crashes, request logs, and tee stderr.
3. `~/.foreman/logs` survives broker teardown; `/tmp/foreman-server-stopgated.log` does not (tmp rotates).

## Evidence

- `ls -la ~/.foreman/logs/` shows 2094 files, newest `Jul 26 12:57` — no entries from today's Phoenix run.
- `ls -la /tmp/foreman-server-stopgated.log` shows `Aug 10 08:37` (latest request log entry).
- The Phoenix server boots cleanly with `mix phx.server`; `Logger` writes to stdout, which the `hub start … tee` captures. No Logger backend config currently targets `~/.foreman/logs`.

## Suggested fix (not in scope)

- Configure a `LoggerFileBackend`-style backend in `config/runtime.exs` (or `config/dev.exs`) that mirrors each request log line to `~/.foreman/logs/<yyyy-mm-dd>.log`, rotating daily.
- For per-run isolation, scope writes by `run_id` once available in the Plug pipeline.
- Keep `/tmp/foreman-server-stopgated.log` as the boot supervisor mirror; primary operational log moves to `~/.foreman/logs/`.

## Scope

Out of scope for any current TRD. Capture and revisit when next touching the Phoenix logging layer.

Never reads `project_id` from `ProjectionStore.run_projection/1`. **Single mutation surface:** `POST /api/commands` (per `AGENTS.md`). Two new resource routes only (`GET /api/projects/:id`, `GET /api/projects`). All `run.start` dispatch flows through `RunAdmission` (the gateway allowlist does NOT include `run.start`; CLI/HTTP cannot bypass). ### 2c. No sentinel field/atom — `defp` privacy is the capability. | Modify (1 new public function + 1 new private function + 1 runtime guard) | | `foreman_server/aggregates/project.ex` | Extend `State` with `active_run_reservations: %{String.t() => reservation_metadata()}` (a map keyed by `run_id` storing canonical `command_id`, `sequence`, `run_start_payload`, and `project_id`); add `handle_command` for `project.reserve_run` (idempotent upsert into the map) and `project.release_run_reservation` (idempotent remove from the map); `project.archive` checks `map_size(state.active_run_reservations) == 0` before emitting `ProjectArchived`. `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReserved` folds the reservation metadata into the map; `apply_event` for `ProjectRunReservationReleased` removes the entry. The reconcile path uses `Run.load(run_id)` to rehydrate state. | Modify (1 State field + 1 apply_event + 5 handle_command event builders) | | `foreman_server/run_admission.ex` | Thin delegate. `start/2` calls `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2` (the protocol owner). No protocol logic in this module — calling `RunAdmission.start/2` is equivalent to calling `CommandRouter.dispatch_run_start/2`. The module exists to (a) give the public API a single documented name, (b) centralize the architecture test allowlist (only `RunAdmission` may call `dispatch_run_start/2`). The reconciler also calls `RunAdmission.start/2` to retry orphan reservations, using the idempotent reserve-and-run flow (the first step is idempotent when the run_id is already a key in the project's `active_run_reservations`). | New | | `foreman_server/run_lifecycle_reconciler.ex` | Supervised GenServer. **Responsibility A (terminal-event subscription):** subscribes to `RunCompleted`, `RunFailed`, `RunCancelled`, `RunBlocked`, `RunFlaggedStuck`; reads `project_id` directly from the event payload (the typed event is the authoritative source); dispatches `project.release_run_reservation`. Sub-second happy-path release. **Responsibility B (scheduled crash-recovery pass, default 60s):** enumerates `(project_id, run_id)` pairs via `ProjectionStore.list_projects_with_active_runs/0` (projection used only for enumeration). For each pair, rehydrates `Run.load(run_id)` to read `Run.State.exists?` and `Run.State.terminal?` (event stream replay), and `Project.load(project_id)` to read `Project.State.active_run_reservations[run_id]` (event-stream-derived state). **Retry-not-release protocol:** if `Run.State.terminal? == true` → release. If `Run.State.exists? == false` → recover the reservation metadata from `active_run_reservations[run_id]` and call `RunAdmission.start(recovered_payload)` to retry the run.start (the reserve is idempotent; the run.start uses the deterministic command_id so concurrent appends are merged via actor-level event dedup). If `Run.State.exists? == true` and `Run.State.terminal? == false` → retain. The protocol never releases on absence alone (TOCTOU closed). | New | | `foreman_server/events/project_run_reserved.ex` | `ProjectRunReserved{run_id, project_id, sequence, command_id, run_start_payload}` — append-only fact that a run was reserved; carries the canonical command ID and the full input needed to retry `run.start` (so the reconciler can recover the run.start payload from project state, not by re-scanning the event stream). `run_start_payload` is the verbatim input passed to `RunAdmission.start/2` (task_id, workflow_snapshot, etc.). | New | | `foreman_server/events/project_run_reservation_released.ex` | `ProjectRunReservationReleased{run_id, project_id, sequence, reason}` — append-only fact that a run was released | New | | `foreman_server/event_codec.ex` | Register `:project_run_reserved` and `:project_run_reservation_released` (typed modules + enforce_keys including `run_start_payload` for the reservation event). Extend `@enforce_keys_registry` for `RunCompleted` (`[:run_id, :project_id, :sequence]`), `RunFailed` (`[:run_id, :project_id, :sequence]`). Add `RunCancelled`, `RunFlaggedStuck`, and `RunBlocked` as typed events (currently untyped maps — AGENTS.md mandates typed events for every domain event): `RunCancelled => [:run_id, :project_id, :reason]`, `RunFlaggedStuck => [:run_id, :project_id, :flagged_at]`, `RunBlocked => [:run_id, :project_id, :phase_id, :reason]`. The reconciler is the ONLY caller; this function is used for enumeration only. **No `run_projection/1`** — the reconciliation path uses `Run.load(run_id)` and the typed event payload for safety decisions, never a projection. The previous design's `run_projection/1` was removed because it relied on projection reads for safety decisions, which races the event-commit boundary. | Modify (1 new query function) | | `foreman_server/application.ex` | Add `RunLifecycleReconciler` to supervision tree under `ForemanServer.Supervisor`; configure `:run_reconciler_interval_ms` (default 60_000) | Modify (supervision tree) | | `foreman_server/workflow/dispatcher.ex` | Replace direct `CommandGateway.dispatch_system(%{type: "run.start", ...})` call with `RunAdmission.start/2` (the ONLY legitimate caller of `run.start`) | Modify (1 call site) | | `foreman_server/project_store.ex` | No change — `list/0` and `get/1` already exist | None | | `foreman_server/telemetry.ex` (or equivalent) | Emit `[:foreman_server, :project, :register | :update | :archive | :read | :list | :run_reserved | :run_reservation_released]` and `[:foreman_server, :reconciler, :terminal_release | :orphan_retry]` with `duration_ms`, `outcome`, optional `code`/`retryable` (note: `:orphan_retry` replaces the v1.0.0 `:orphan_released` event — v1.0.1+ does not release on absence, it retries) | Modify (extend handlers) | | `foreman_cli/cmd/foreman/project.go` (new) and `foreman_cli/cmd/foreman/main.go` (modify) | Five subcommands: `create`, `get`, `update`, `delete`, `list` | New + modify | | `foreman_cli/internal/client/client.go` | Exit-code mapping for 6 documented codes (0,1,2,3,4,5) | Modify (extend error handling) | | `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/cli-reference.md` | Document the new `project` subcommand grouping, exit codes, and the `delete` ↔ `archive` mapping | Modify | | `test/foreman_server_web/event_store_web_enforcement_test.exs` (new) | Mirror `event_store_enforcement_test.exs` for the web layer. Allowlist: `CommandRouter` (the `dispatch_run_start/2` function itself), `RunAdmission` (the protocol delegate), and `RunLifecycleReconciler` (the retry path). Excluded from the scan: `test/` and `run_test.exs` (aggregate unit tests call `Run.handle_command/2` directly and never dispatch through the router). | New | | `test/foreman_server/event_codec_test.exs` (existing) | Add coverage for the two new event types (round-trip encode/decode) | Modify (extend) | ### 2d.
